headline: Ashton Kutcher leaving Sound Ventures to launch new VC firm with Morgan Beller
context: Sound built its reputation on concentrated, high-conviction bets in category-leading AI labs, while Kutcher's new fund appears to be chasing the layer underneath those companies — the infrastructure and energy that power them.
